blk_part_03_part_3_casual_style_serious_.text: A customer may ask directly, “How long will it take?” A plain complaint may be, “This coffee is cold.” These words can sound strong, but they clearly show the problem. Good business service focuses on the problem and fixes it. Australian cafe culture often values drink quality more than loud marketing, so exaggerated claims may create less trust.
